doe-osti-2583799-time-log-of-the-unloadi:
Oak Ridge letter report ORNL/LTR-2025/3958, by Riley Cumberland and Bruce Bevard in August 2025, is a stopwatch record of a spent fuel cask unloading. On January 21, 2016, a NAC-LWT legal weight truck cask arrived at Oak Ridge on a semi, inside a shipping container built to be taken apart. The log begins at 12:55 with the grapple attaching to lift the container's top. It proceeds minute by minute through impact limiter removal and every move after.

Nobody had published baseline handling times at this detail, and the NE-8 program needs them. Throughput estimates for a consolidated storage site are built bottom-up from single steps. The authors caution that Oak Ridge's area suits cask receipt but is not built for daily use. A purpose-built site could run faster; larger rail casks would slow things down. The document is data, offered so planners can estimate from observation instead of guesswork.
